_README: Drives ../tts-twitch/scripts/translate-catalogs.js, shared with the bot and web UI. Run it from the bot checkout: `node scripts/translate-catalogs.js --config ../wildcat-docs/i18n.config.json`. The wildcat-tts and chatoverlay catalogs are listed: the other three (common, index, botcommands) were translated by hand, are in step with English, and are deliberately out of this script's reach.
_spoken: Documentation read off a screen, never synthesised.
_locales: The docs ship eight languages, hand-translated for the other three catalogs and listed in src/scripts/i18n.js. Without this the script would generate the bot's other thirty-one, which the language switcher does not offer.
role: You translate technical documentation for a live-streaming text-to-speech bot and a stream chat overlay.
context: Reference documentation shown on a docs website. The English source is written to ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, plain words, one meaning per word, active voice. Keep the translation equally plain and direct. Do not add emphasis, marketing tone, or words the English does not have.
extraRules: These strings contain HTML. Reproduce every tag, attribute and entity exactly as written, including , , < and >. Never translate a class name or any other attribute value. Translate only the visible text between the tags.
Text inside <span class="inline-code"> is a command, a setting name, or a literal value. Keep it in English exactly as written, including the surrounding punctuation.
A short phrase in quotation marks is what the bot says out loud in an English channel. Keep it in English and keep the quotation marks, as the existing catalogs for this project already do.

glossary.channel: a streamer's Twitch or YouTube channel
glossary.channel default: the setting a moderator applies to the whole channel, as opposed to one viewer's personal setting
glossary.entry: one word-to-pronunciation pair in the pronunciation dictionary
glossary.built-in entry: a pronunciation entry that ships with the bot, as opposed to one a moderator added
glossary.emote: a small custom image used in stream chat
glossary.voice engine: the speech synthesis service that turns text into audio
